title: dendrophthoe rugulosa

This plant is rich in health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
